requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Specific Page Yields
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for Black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet new market demands for higher yield and minimize user intervention, supporting longer print cycles.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink compatibility, bottle manufacturing, printer hardware design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB keyed bottles are available in specified capacities and pass yield validation tests with supported printers.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Design ink bottles and filling mechanisms to ensure spill-free operation during user replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces service calls due to spills or contamination.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User testing demonstrates no ink spills during standard replacement procedures.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F component with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining existing click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances security and reliability of ink delivery, leveraging proven mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F units pass mechanical and reliability tests with new features.

requirements.Title: Reuse of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Inks
requirements.Description: Continue use of SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and leverages existing validated components.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new hardware and bottle design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No reformulation required; components pass integration tests in new printer.

requirements.Title: Reliability & Performance Modeling
requirements.Description: Model and validate reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, IDS, startup, and NOA-F EOL (End of Life).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures robust performance and longevity of ink system under various conditions.
requirements.Dependencies: Access to data, simulation tools, test hardware
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All models are validated and performance meets defined thresholds under test conditions.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling
requirements.Description: Develop models to predict ink stability in tank, including impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: Prevents print quality degradation and supports longer tank lifespans.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stability models predict no significant PQ impact over defined service intervals.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts for Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F components must be available as service parts for in-warranty repairs and replacements.
requirements.Rationale: Supports serviceability and warranty commitments for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts are stocked and available for warranty service requests.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 feature into the ink bottle lid for enhanced tracking or authentication.
requirements.Rationale: Improves supply chain traceability and counterfeit prevention.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 functionality is validated in production lids.

requirements.Title: Factory Line Modifications for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 factory line to support NOA-F; add Magi ink cartridge and labeling tool in Orcus 5.
requirements.Rationale: Enables efficient manufacturing and assembly of new features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines are updated and pass production readiness reviews.

requirements.Title: New Mold for Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Develop molds for 1 to 4 new keyed ink bottle caps as part of the new bottle system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports new bottle keying and prevents incorrect bottle usage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New caps are produced and validated for fit and function.

requirements.Title: Support Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Ensure that both PHA and NOA-F are user-replaceable components in the field.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime for end users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can replace PHA and NOA-F following provided instructions with no tools required.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Set new warranty page life target at 80,000 pages for the Magellan printer series.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive benchmarks and customer expectations for durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers achieve 80,000 pages without failure under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: Size Increase for Tank with Reddington ID
requirements.Description: Increase tank size to support higher capacity, maintaining Reddington ID design cues.
requirements.Rationale: Supports longer print cycles and larger bottle sizes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank accommodates larger bottles and passes fit validation.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for shipping and protection of the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Improves product protection during shipping and meets regulatory requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop and vibration tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan printer meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates sales in regulated markets and supports corporate sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Products are certified to EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel standards prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion resulting from increased size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and user convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function properly with new tank design and pass user testing.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3” CGD (Color Graphic Display) as standard for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user interface and supports advanced printer functions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is functional and passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: New Tube Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for the 4-tube platform.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink flow efficiency and supports new tank layout.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube routing supports required flow rates and passes assembly tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station to manage aerosols generated due to new tank and spit platform changes.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station design, aerosol management solutions
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within safe limits during operation.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Model and validate carriage dynamics and forces with new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical reliability and print quality with updated hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force limits and passes reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Paperpath Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paperpath design to support increased page life and durability.
requirements.Rationale: Enables the new 80,000-page warranty life goal.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath components pass accelerated life testing for 80,000 pages.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post 80K Life
requirements.Description: Make ink maintenance a serviceable part at service centers after 80,000-page printer life.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces total cost of ownership and supports extended use beyond warranty.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance part post-80K life.

requirements.Title: New IDS Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection in IDS, leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and prevents incorrect connections.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, LEBI ink-tank, SHAID integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes connection and reliability tests with new features.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new startup algorithm and air management system for IDS to ensure optimal ink flow and minimize startup issues.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances startup reliability and print readiness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup success rate exceeds 99% in field testing.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality (PQ) Goals & Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality goals and depletion definitions to align with updated page yield targets.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer satisfaction and accurate yield reporting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion metrics are met in standardized test runs.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Continue use of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and leverages proven components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function correctly in Magellan platform integration tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity in the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern connectivity standards and enhances user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity and interoperability tests.

requirements.Title: FW Dune and Gauss4.xx Security Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate FW Dune and Gauss4.xx security features into hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures device and data security, meeting corporate and regulatory standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features pass penetration and compliance testing.

requirements.Title: Support PaaS, WorkFromHome, and Flexworker Services
requirements.Description: Enable support for PaaS business models and usage scenarios such as WorkFromHome and Flexworker.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with evolving customer needs and business models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports remote management and subscription services as specified.

requirements.Title: SMB and Enterprise Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate SMB manageability and enterprise support features, including WJA, HPSM, and JAM.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and meets enterprise IT requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Enterprise management features function as intended in customer environments.

requirements.Title: Support for Multiple Client Drivers
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD client drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Maximizes interoperability and ease of deployment across customer environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed drivers are supported and pass functional testing.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence for S’27 Launch
requirements.Description: Meet aggressive time-to-market goals for S’27 with minimal investment, as outlined in the program schedule.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for competitive positioning and revenue targets.
requirements.Stakeholders: Program Management, Product Management, Executive Team
requirements.Dependencies: All development and manufacturing readiness activities
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All milestones in the S’27 schedule are met with no major delays.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must achieve a minimum life of 65,000 pages as a hard constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures core component reliability and meets business priorities.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA meets or exceeds 65,000-page life in testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: Warranty for Magellan printers must cover 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with customer expectations and business optimization priorities.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, End Users, Warranty Service
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and system reflect 2-year/80,000-page coverage.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve throughput speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19 ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Meets performance expectations for target market segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers achieve specified throughput in standardized tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability via Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Enable serviceability through a maintenance box for easier maintenance and reduced downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Improves customer satisfaction and reduces service costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be serviced or replaced as per service guidelines.
